$comment: Every myspec setting: its file, type, default and the issue that introduced it (docs/project-settings-design.md, principle 7). lib/myspec-config.sh and lib/myspec-config.mjs read it to build the framework-default layer and to type-check the project layer; doctor validates against it. Keys under 'verification.' live in .claude/verification.json, every other key in .myspec.json. 'type' lists the JSON types a value may have. 'merge' says how a list combines across layers: 'extend' appends a later layer's entries (principle 3), 'replace' lets the later layer win, which existing lists keep so that no project's behaviour changes (principle 2). A key with no 'default' is absent unless a layer sets it. 'loosens' marks a setting that weakens a gate, which doctor lists. 'catalogue': false marks a key the design's catalogue tables do not list; lib/tests/myspec-config.test.sh checks every other key against those tables. 'env' is the session layer: an 'override' sets 'key' to 'value' when the variable matches 'match'; the other kinds are read or exported by one script and set no key.

aiDir.description: Directory holding the framework-managed docs, repo-relative, no trailing slash.

frameworkVersion.description: Bookkeeping: the framework version init or update last installed.

project.description: Bookkeeping: name, description and techStack recorded by init.

migrations.description: Bookkeeping: the one-shot migrations update has already run.

frameworkFiles.description: Pins: framework files update must not overwrite.

topologyFile.description: Repo-relative path of the project topology file (setup backbone).

reuseAudit.enabled.description: false turns off the reuse-audit gate on tech specs.

feedback.metrics.description: false stops record-session-metrics.sh writing field metrics.

feedback.frictionReport.description: false stops session-complete offering the friction report.

isolation.blockInMain.description: Anchored EREs: extra commands blocked in the main checkout while a session is in worktree mode.

isolation.allowLinkedModules.description: Accept a linked dependency tree at the Stop gate.

isolation.worktreeRoot.description: Repo-relative directory worktrees are created under.

isolation.provision.symlink.description: Paths or {path, lockfiles} objects linked from the main checkout into a new worktree.

isolation.provision.copy.description: Paths or {path, mode} objects copied into a new worktree; a directory and mode "clone" are #222.

isolation.provision.clean.description: Repo-relative globs deleted in a new worktree before any check runs.

isolation.provision.install.description: A command, or a list of {run, cwd, when} steps, run in a new worktree after links, copies and cleans.

hooks.markCodeChanged.extraCodeExtension.description: Extensions treated as code in addition to the framework's CODE_EXT.

hooks.markCodeChanged.ignorePaths.description: Repo-relative globs whose writes never arm the stop gate by themselves.

verification.notes.description: Free text for the humans editing the file; never read by the gate.

verification.checks.description: The checks the Stop gate runs.

verification.checks[].command.description: Command run from the repo root.

verification.checks[].diffCommand.description: Command run instead of command when a merge base exists, with MYSPEC_BASE_REF exported.

verification.checks[].cleanup.description: Command the gate runs after it kills a check at the cap.

verification.checks[].required.description: Only a check with required: true runs at the gate.

verification.checks[].paths.description: Run the check only when a file this session wrote in this checkout matches one of these globs: repo-relative, anchored at the root, * and ? within one segment, ** as a whole segment for any depth (docs/stop-gate.md, Per-check settings). An unusable value is ignored and the check runs.

verification.containers.description: Map of container name to {mountSource, mountTarget}: mountSource the repo-relative directory the container mounts (usually "."), mountTarget the absolute path it is mounted at inside the container.

verification.checks[].runIn.description: Name of the container (in containers) the check's command runs in. The check gets MYSPEC_CHECK_WORKDIR and is exempt from the linked-worktree container-exec refusal; it is refused when the container is undefined or cannot see this checkout.

DO_NOT_TRACK.description: The cross-tool opt-out: any value but empty, 0, false or FALSE turns field metrics off, as in hooks/record-session-metrics.sh.

MYSPEC_DISABLE_FRICTION_REPORT.description: Session opt-out of the friction report.

MYSPEC_CHECK_CAP_SECONDS.description: Lowers the Stop gate's per-check time cap; it cannot raise it.

MYSPEC_METRICS_CAP_SECONDS.description: Lowers the metrics hook's time cap; it cannot raise it.

MYSPEC_SKIP_MEMORY_DOCTOR.description: 1 skips memory-claim-id.sh's doctor step (its test fixture).

MYSPEC_ALLOW_BRANCH_OPS.description: A command prefixed with MYSPEC_ALLOW_BRANCH_OPS=1 passes guard-worktree-context.sh gate A.

MYSPEC_ALLOW_MAIN_CHECKOUT.description: A command prefixed with MYSPEC_ALLOW_MAIN_CHECKOUT=1 passes guard-worktree-context.sh gate B.

MYSPEC_BASE_REF.description: Exported by the Stop gate to checks: the merge base with the default branch.

MYSPEC_SESSION_FILES.description: Exported by the Stop gate to checks: the files this session wrote in this checkout.

MYSPEC_CHECK_RUN_ID.description: Exported by the Stop gate to a check and its cleanup: one id per run.

MYSPEC_STOP_HOOK_ACTIVE.description: Exported by the Stop gate to checks so a check that ends a nested session does not re-enter the gate.

MYSPEC_WORKTREE.description: Exported by worktree-provision.sh to each install step: the worktree being provisioned.

MYSPEC_MAIN_CHECKOUT.description: Exported by worktree-provision.sh to each install step: the checkout links point into.

MYSPEC_CHECK_WORKDIR.description: Exported by the Stop gate to a check with runIn: this checkout's path inside the container.
